name: phd-transfer-unreviewed-attested
description: The student's own “transfer approved” checkbox cannot clear a course the DGS has never reviewed (DGS 2026-09-11: “Do not let never-reviewed courses count even with the checkbox checked”). A university with no row has no credit system on record, and the line says the credits are shown as printed.
